subject: Vendor enrollment: MSA redlines + procurement portal provisioning
messages:
From: Procurement Team <procurement@novahealthsys.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Sutton <maya.sutton@novahealthsys.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding: PO requirements & Ariba registration

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking this. We're starting vendor onboarding for Redwood to enable POs and A/P integration. A few asks from procurement to get the supplier record approved in Ariba and avoid PO mismatches:

- Please register as a supplier in our Ariba portal (we can invite or you can self-register). We need the Ariba supplier ID and the exact company legal name used for tax docs.
- Required docs to attach in the portal: W9 (or W-8 if applicable), Certificate of Insurance (COI), and the PO remit/invoice email.
- We will issue POs that include a Buyer PO Number, Project Code, and Line Item detail — tell us which Order Form fields map to these so our AP mapping team can set up EDI correctly.
- Please confirm Redwood's billing contact and the email for invoices.

Attaching our PO template so you can confirm the mapping. Once Ariba supplier ID is created, please send it back and we'll request the first PO.

Appreciate quick turnaround — procurement aims to complete onboarding this week if possible.

Attachments: PO_template.xlsx

Thanks,
Procurement Team
Nova Health Systems
procurement@novahealthsys.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@novahealthsys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: PO requirements & Ariba registration

Hi Maya / Procurement,

Thanks — looping in Karthik (sales lead) and Laura (legal) so we can move quickly on the MSAs and order form mapping. Quick summary / next steps from our side: 

1) Registration: We can self-register and will share the Ariba supplier ID when complete. Please confirm whether you want Redwood to request the initial invitation or you will invite us.

2) Docs: Attached is our draft Order Form (Draft_OrderForm_Redwood_Nova_v1.pdf). Key mapping recommendations (for your AP team):
   - Buyer PO Number -> order_form.purchase_order_number
   - Project Code -> order_form.project_code
   - Line items -> order_form.line_items[].description and .unit_price
   - Invoice destination -> finance.invoices@redwood.com

3) Legal: Laura — see attached Order Form for fields likely to be negotiated (term, payment SLA, liability cap, data processing clause). We expect a short redline cycle. Preferred flow: sign MSA via DocuSign first, then Ariba/PO for each Order Form so PO numbers match the signed order. If procurement requires MSA via portal/workflow instead, note that we need to ensure the signed MSA is referenceable from the Ariba supplier record.

4) Attachments you requested: W9/COI will be uploaded to the Ariba portal. We will also attach a short onboarding checklist to the supplier record.

Doc links: DocuSign MSA draft will be provided once legal confirms redlines (link to follow).

Attaching: Draft_OrderForm_Redwood_Nova_v1.pdf

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk the mapping live.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novahealthsys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: PO requirements & Ariba registration

On Sat, Nov 21, 2026 at 11:45 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:
> 2) Docs: Attached is our draft Order Form (Draft_OrderForm_Redwood_Nova_v1.pdf). Key mapping recommendations ...

Thanks, Stephanie and team. I reviewed the draft Order Form and the attached MSA excerpt. High-level legal summary and requests before Redwood signs anything: 

- Liability cap: Our standard cap is liability limited to the greater of $2M or the total fees paid in the prior 12 months; we can accept $1M for small pilots but would like $2M for production deals. Please confirm Nova Health Systems' target.
- Indemnity/IP carveouts: We need explicit carveouts for model-output claims and for compliance with law; we will propose limited indemnity tied to breach and wilful misconduct only.
- Data processing: Add a DPA attachment or reference to our standard DPA. If you require Nova's standard DPA language in the MSA, please provide a copy and we will review.
- Auto-renew: We prefer a 12-month term with automatic renewal only with 30-day opt-out; if Nova requires automatic renew without notice, we need an explicit termination right for breach and a 60-day notice for price increases.
- Flow for signing: We can execute the MSA via DocuSign and then accept POs in Ariba referencing the signed DocuSign agreement. If Nova's procurement team mandates signature capture inside Ariba (workflow approval), Redwood legal will need visibility to the signed artifact and a copy of the Ariba skeleton (to confirm metadata can be exported).

I've attached a redline (RF_MSA_redlines_v1.docx) with inline comments. Key items are commented in the doc. Laura will be available for a 30-minute call Tues/Wed to walk the redlines if useful.

Attachments: RF_MSA_redlines_v1.docx

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Maya Sutton <maya.sutton@novahealthsys.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novahealthsys.com>, Ariba Vendor Support <vendor-support@ariba.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: PO requirements & Ariba registration

Stephanie / Laura,

Thanks for the clear breakdown and Laura, appreciate the redline. A couple quick updates from Nova: 

- We created the supplier record in Ariba this morning. Ariba supplier ID: ARIBA-7785123. We uploaded the W9 and COI to the supplier folder; see attached W9.
- Procurement's target liability cap is $1.5M for this vendor class — I know that's between the two numbers mentioned; please confirm Redwood's flexibility.
- For signature flow: procurement prefers Ariba workflow for record completeness, but we can support DocuSign as long as the signed MSA PDF is attached to the Ariba supplier record AND the Ariba PO references the DocuSign agreement ID. Our Ariba admin (cc'd vendor-support) can help map a custom field for agreement_id on the supplier record.
- Invoicing: please send invoices to ap_invoices@novahealthsys.com and add the Buyer PO Number in the invoice subject and body.

Next actions requested from Redwood:
- Confirm whether you accept $1.5M liability cap or propose language that bridges the gap.
- Upload the signed MSA PDF or confirm plan to attach DocuSign output to Ariba.
- Confirm Redwood billing contact and we will push first PO once the Ariba metadata is configured.

Attachments: W9_NovaHealth.pdf

Thanks,
Maya Sutton
Senior Procurement Manager | Nova Health Systems
maya.sutton@novahealthsys.com
